summary.text: Wife of Areilycus (`areilycus-achaean`) and mother of Arcesilaus and Prothoënor in Hyginus' catalogue of the Boeotian captains — Homer names only Areilycus as father of Prothoënor at his death.

story.text: Hyginus counts Arcesilaus son of Areilycus and Theobula among the Boeotian captains with ten ships, and Prothoënor his brother from Thespia with eight.
